description: A utility class that acts as an interface to Android's native logging system, providing methods to log messages at various levels and manage a chain of LogNode objects. It replaces or wraps android.util.Log functionality for consistent logging across a project.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods to log messages at various priority levels and manage a chain of LogNode objects. Serves as an abstraction over Android's native Log class to facilitate custom logging implementations.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current head of the LogNode chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches log messages to the current LogNode, specifying priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion (fatal error) message with optional Throwable.
